versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

xiaohongshu-policy-talking 0.1.1

- Added initial SKILL.md describing skill purpose, requirements, and workflow.
- Outlines the process to turn Xiaohongshu policy-question notes into short talking policy clips (2–15s) from supplied public-policy facts.
- Clarifies what inputs and permissions are required (policy note links/text, public-policy lines, presenter still, rights, clip count).
- Details step-by-step plan for input inspection, note lookup, clone, speech, and video card confirmation, with billing and authorization checks.
- Emphasizes that the skill never invents policy data or stitches clips; all output must be based on desk-supplied facts.
